summary: std/x509: an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (::ffff:a.b.c.d) in a SAN or an IP name constraint is a parse error, as Go 1.27.4
details: an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (::ffff:a.b.c.d) in a SAN or an IP name constraint is a parse error, as Go 1.27.4; such a SAN matched an IPv4 host while escaping IPv4 excluded ranges. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/x509, native backends): an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (::ffff:a.b.c.d) in a SAN or an IP name constraint is a parse error, as Go 1.27.4; such a SAN matched an IPv4 host while escaping IPv4 excluded ranges. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
